title: Dashing Dan, A game I made using AI for a game Jam.
author: Famous-Plum7053
selftext: [Hi guys, I made this during the last 2 weeks and would love some feedback on it. You can try it on www.dashingdan.fun ](https://reddit.com/link/1jru1ta/video/2aumfgv2oxse1/player)

comments.author: Famous-Plum7053
comments.body:
It's made with three.js and runs in browser. Mobile works, but I don't recommend it.   
[dashingdan.fun](http://dashingdan.fun)

replies.author: abutun
replies.body: Not bad but needs a lot of improvements

replies.author: Famous-Plum7053
replies.body:
Thanks a lot for the reply.  
Any pointers as to what I should improve in particular?  
It's quite fun to play to me, but I guess I'm kinda blind to the flaws since I made it and spent so much time testing it.

replies.author: QuoteDull
replies.body: Mainly UI/UX, color palette, animations, art style, and the feel of the game. Seems like you got a decent concept, just needs an art direction and a cohesive UI
